title: Most people are burning through their Claude limit with zero idea how close they are to the wall
description:
Most people are burning through their Claude limit with zero idea how close they are to the wall.

Then they hit it mid-build and lose all momentum.

There’s a free counter that sits right inside Claude and shows your token usage, your limit, and how much context window you’ve got left. Live, every single time.

Drop into the Chrome extensions, flip on developer mode, drag the folder in, refresh. Done.

Comment “TOKEN” and I’ll send you the repo 🔥
